description: Search live or sold Yahoo Auctions Japan listings by keyword, category, seller or item ID. Filter by price, condition, listing type and prefecture, then enrich rows with full item details.

buyItNowOnly.description: Only return listings that offer a buy-it-now price.
buyItNowOnly.title: Has buy-it-now price

categoryIds.description: Yahoo Auctions category IDs, e.g. 23336 for Computers. Used by browseCategory and as an optional filter for keywordSearch/soldSearch.
categoryIds.title: Category IDs

condition.description: Only return listings in this condition grade.
condition.title: Item condition

excludeKeywords.description: Listings containing any of these words are removed (all search modes).
excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords

freeShippingOnly.description: Only return listings whose seller offers free shipping.
freeShippingOnly.title: Free shipping only

includeDetails.description: Open each item page to add description, all photos, bidder count, seller rating/location and shipping methods. Adds one request per record.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full item details

itemIds.description: Auction IDs or item page URLs (mode=itemDetails), e.g. w1250838886 or https://page.auctions.yahoo.co.jp/jp/auction/w1250838886.
itemIds.title: Item IDs or URLs

maxItems.description: Maximum number of auction records to return across all keywords and pages.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxPrice.description: Only include listings at or below this price in yen.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (JPY)

minPrice.description: Only include listings at or above this price in yen.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (JPY)

mode.description: What to scrape on Yahoo Auctions Japan.
enumTitles: Item details (by item ID or URL)
mode.title: Mode

prefecture.description: Only include listings located in this prefecture.
prefecture.title: Item location

priceType.description: Use the current bid price or the buy-it-now price for minPrice/maxPrice.
priceType.title: Price filter applies to

searchQueries.description: One or more keywords, Japanese or English (mode=keywordSearch, soldSearch). Each keyword is searched separately until maxItems is reached.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

sellerIds.description: Seller IDs or seller page URLs (mode=sellerListings), e.g. FCm8JEeKSC4qTg4Ww3SAS54XL2aKF.
sellerIds.title: Seller IDs

sortBy.description: Result order. When Yahoo's JSON endpoint is unavailable, fallback pages are sorted locally within each fetched page window.
enumTitles: Total price incl. shipping: low to high
Total price incl. shipping: high to low
sortBy.title: Sort by

title: Yahoo Auctions Japan Live & Sold Auction Scraper Input
